summary: Ethlabs 在 Ethereum Magicians 发布 pqai27 提案，主张以太坊在 2027 年完成后量子和后 AI 加固，Hegotá 优先 Frames 与后量子账户，FOCIL 让路，Ethlabs 自己撤回 quick slots。今晚 ACDC #191 会简短讨论。账户相关的 EIP-8141、EIP-8250、EIP-8151、EIP-8288 都有新的修订 PR。

items.topic: pqai27：Ethlabs 提议 2027 年完成后量子与后 AI 加固
items.title: Ethlabs：An Ethlabs view on post-quantum and post-AI timelines: pqai27
items.note: 2026-11-12 03:51 发布于 Magicians。核心主张：以太坊应在 2027 年达到 pqai-ready，即共识层后量子化、每个用户的账户都有后量子迁移路径，同时保持 Glamsterdam 带来的扩容容量；pqai-scaled（后量子交易和 blob 满容量运行）是 2027 年的延伸目标。
items.title_en: Ethlabs: An Ethlabs view on post-quantum and post-AI timelines: pqai27
items.note_en: Posted on Magicians at 03:51 on 2026-11-12. The core claim is that Ethereum should reach "pqai-ready" in 2027: consensus is post-quantum and every user has a post-quantum migration path for their account, while keeping the capacity Glamsterdam delivers. "pqai-scaled", with post-quantum transactions and blobs at full capacity, is the stretch goal for 2027.

items.topic: 账户抽象与交易：Frames 生态的 EIP 一夜四改
items.title: EIP-8141 补充：SENDER frame 何时让交易在执行前就无效
items.note: 2026-11-12 07:12 提交：只有带 APPROVE_EXECUTION 标志的 frame 能设置 sender_approved，所以前面没有这种 frame 的 SENDER frame 一定失败，builder 和 mempool 可以不执行就丢弃。
items.title_en: EIP-8141 note: when a SENDER frame makes a transaction invalid before execution
items.note_en: Opened at 07:12 on 2026-11-12. Only a frame flagged APPROVE_EXECUTION can set sender_approved, so a SENDER frame with no such frame before it always fails, and builders and mempools can drop the transaction without executing anything.

items.topic: 账户抽象与交易：Frames 生态的 EIP 一夜四改
items.title: EIP-8250 更新：一次性 keyed 交易可通过静态和 mempool 检查
items.note: 2026-11-12 07:12 提交：nonce_seq 等于 MAX_NONCE_SEQ 且所选 key 都为 0 时视为可执行，不算 nonce 溢出；重放保护不变。
items.title_en: EIP-8250 update: single-use keyed transactions pass static and mempool checks
items.note_en: Opened at 07:12 on 2026-11-12. When nonce_seq equals MAX_NONCE_SEQ and every selected key reads zero, the transaction counts as executable rather than a nonce overflow. Replay protection is unchanged.

items.title: EIP-8151 更新：为 recovered signer 增加公共 mempool 规则
items.note: 2026-11-12 01:20 提交：在 EIP-8151 下 ecRecover 会读取恢复地址的代码，EIP-8141 的验证前缀因此可能依赖第三方账户，这个 PR 补上对应的 mempool 规则。
items.title_en: EIP-8151 update: public mempool rules for recovered signers
items.note_en: Opened at 01:20 on 2026-11-12. Under EIP-8151, ecRecover reads the recovered address's code, so an EIP-8141 validation prefix can depend on a third-party account. This PR adds the matching mempool rules.

items.title: 新 EIP 草案：Code Reads in Block-Level Access Lists
items.note: 2026-11-12 07:12 由 LukaszRozmej 提交：在 EIP-7928 的 AccountChanges 中加入 code_hash，这样 BAL 能列出区块读取的全部区块前状态，无状态客户端或证明者只用区块、BAL 和状态快照就能组装输入，不必先执行区块。对应的 Magicians 讨论帖 于 2026-11-12 07:14 开启。
items.title_en: New draft EIP: Code Reads in Block-Level Access Lists
items.note_en: Opened by LukaszRozmej at 07:12 on 2026-11-12. It adds a code_hash to EIP-7928's AccountChanges, so the BAL names every piece of pre-block state a block reads and a stateless client or prover can build its input from the block, the BAL and a state snapshot without executing the block. The Magicians discussion thread opened at 07:14 on 2026-11-12.

items.title: ethresear.ch：Elastic Ethereum
items.note: 2026-11-11 18:40 由 cskiraly 发布的观点帖：主张按测得的资源压力动态调整容量，像 TCP 拥塞控制那样，而不是固定 gas 上限加安全余量。文中引用主网数据称，区块中位数在首次被看到后 0.38 秒到达 95% 的上报节点（99 分位区块为 0.70 秒）。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Elastic Ethereum
items.note_en: An opinion post by cskiraly at 18:40 on 2026-11-11. It argues for adjusting capacity to measured resource pressure, the way TCP congestion control does, instead of a fixed gas limit plus a safety margin. Citing mainnet data, it says the median block reaches 95% of reporting nodes 0.38 seconds after it is first seen (0.70 seconds for the 99th percentile block).
items.topic_en: Infrastructure: code reads in BAL, and a case for elastic capacity

summary_en: Ethlabs posted its pqai27 proposal on Ethereum Magicians, arguing that Ethereum should become post-quantum and post-AI hardened in 2027. Hegotá would prioritize Frames and post-quantum accounts, FOCIL would step aside, and Ethlabs is withdrawing quick slots. It gets a short slot on tonight's ACDC #191, and the account-related EIP-8141, EIP-8250, EIP-8151 and EIP-8288 all picked up new revision PRs.
